# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 66 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 66

Jesus said: "Point out to me the stone the builders threw away — that is the keystone."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Point out to me" — the imperative is more direct and concrete
- "Threw away" — more vivid than "rejected" for the builders' dismissal
- "Keystone" — alternative rendering of the capstone/cornerstone concept, emphasizing structural centrality
